phase_contract: Each original compared with two FIRST arms and each arm's own independent displayed-FIRST BACK. ONE call per leg, no retry or hidden judge.

phases.name: DISCOVERY_A
phases.arms: SERVICE_FIRST + frozen BACK versus NX_BOUND_FIRST + same frozen BACK

phases.name: REFINEMENT_B
phases.arms: NX_BOUND_FIRST+BACK versus NX_FEWSHOT_FIRST+BACK; validate bilingual exemplars before paid use

phases.name: INDEPENDENT_FINAL
phases.arms: SERVICE_FIRST+BACK versus frozen winner_FIRST+BACK; no further tuning on FINAL

privacy: External private 2000-source corpus selected only in owner-private runtime; public GitHub stores no originals. Deduplicate by canonical hash plus family/cluster and prior exposure manifest.
stop_on: Approval ledger mismatch or private key exposure
Any attempted call beyond separately approved limit
Two distinct P0 FIRST failures in a direction without comparable baseline failure: HOLD that profile pending human review
Dependency FIRST failure: skip only its corresponding BACK, count attempted FIRST
forbidden: new API requests before explicit user approval
mix Claude with Gemini in same path
